verdict.rationale: Oneleet explicitly markets multi-framework support (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR) from one platform, with framework management features like adding/removing frameworks and shared/unique controls handled centrally. missing for 10: independent customer confirmation of running HIPAA/PCI/GDPR audits end-to-end, and detail on framework-specific control mapping depth beyond the removal mechanic.
